"""Verify/publish prepared sources and live CPU wait;no GPU admission is executed."""
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import psutil
from phase_admission_protocol import dependency_readiness,read,ref

REPO=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V178-phase-evidence-admission-v1'
LIVE=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'
plan_path=ROOT/'plan-v1.json';plan=read(plan_path)
for binding in plan['inputs']:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
for path,digest in plan['frozen_files'].items():assert ref(path)['sha256']==digest
assert len(plan['cases'])==7
assert len([c for c in plan['cases'] if c['noisy']])==6
assert len([c for c in plan['cases'] if c['domain']=='protected-real'])==2
assert all(c['training_step'] is None for c in plan['cases'] if c['domain']=='protected-real')
assert plan['expected']=={'parity_rows':14,'all_component_calls':32,'frozen_calls':32,'matching_calls':27,'sampler_calls':135,
                         'new_projection_calls':15,'CPU_feature_calls':6,'direct_GPU_feature_calls':3,
                         'optimizer_updates':2,'Adam_tensors':142,'restored_checkpoint_step':1}
assert '18 passed' in plan['protocol_CPU_tests']['text']
readiness_path=ROOT/'frozen-entry-readiness-v1.json';readiness=read(readiness_path)
assert readiness['plan']==ref(plan_path) and readiness['Torch_imported_by_rejected_worker'] is False
assert readiness['CUDA_initialized'] is False and not readiness['scientific_claim_created']
assert readiness['frozen_constructor_trainable_tensors']==142 and readiness['sampler_blocks_per_matching_forward']==5
launch_path=ROOT/'watch-launch-v1.json';launch=read(launch_path)
assert launch['plan']==ref(plan_path) and launch['worker_source']==plan['runner']
watch=read(ROOT/'watch-status-v1.json');owner=launch['owner'];process=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
assert process.create_time()==owner['created'] and watch['owner']==owner
assert process.status() not in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
assert process.nice()==10 and process.cpu_affinity()==[4,5]
no_torch=not any('libtorch' in m.path or 'libcudart' in m.path for m in process.memory_maps())
assert no_torch
assert watch['status']=='waiting-for-train-owner'
absent=['admission-launch-v1.json','admission.claim','admission-result-v1.json','admission-failure-v1.json','watch-failure-v1.json']
assert not any((ROOT/name).exists() for name in absent)
proof=dependency_readiness(plan['dependency_root']);assert not proof['ready'] and proof['reason']=='waiting-for-train-owner'
live=read(LIVE/'plan-v1.json')
for name,digest in live['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(REPO/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==digest
helpers=read(LIVE/'postprocess-inputs-v1.json')['helpers']
for binding in helpers:assert ref(binding['path'])['sha256']==binding['sha256']
train=read(LIVE/'train-status-v1.json');training_process=psutil.Process(train['owner']['pid'])
assert training_process.create_time()==train['owner']['created'] and train['status']=='training'
watch175=read(LIVE/'completion-watch-status-v1.json');p=psutil.Process(watch175['owner']['pid'])
assert p.create_time()==watch175['owner']['created']
sources=[REPO/'scripts'/name for name in ['admit_phase_evidence_matching.py','phase_admission_protocol.py']]+[REPO/'tests/test_phase_admission_protocol.py']
for source in sources:
 frozen=Path(plan['work'])/source.relative_to(REPO)
 assert source.read_bytes()==frozen.read_bytes()
summary={
 'status':'prepared-frozen-CUDA-admission-CPU-watcher-live-no-GPU-work-yet',
 'recorded_local':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat(),
 'plan':dict(ref(plan_path),contents=plan),'sources':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in sources],
 'frozen_entry_readiness':dict(ref(readiness_path),contents=readiness),
 'frozen_entry_log':dict(ref(REPO/'.cache/v178-frozen-admission-readiness-v1.log'),text=(REPO/'.cache/v178-frozen-admission-readiness-v1.log').read_text()),
 'watch_launch':dict(ref(launch_path),contents=launch),'watch_observed':watch,
 'watcher_observed_RSS_bytes':process.memory_info().rss,'watcher_no_loaded_Torch_CUDA_libraries':no_torch,
 'observed_dependency_proof':proof,'observed_live_V175_training':train,
 'original_neural_sources_unchanged':96,'existing_V175_helpers_unchanged':18,
 'absent_scientific_launch_claim_result_files':absent,
 'new_GPU_component_forwards':0,'new_optimizer_updates':0,
 'future_admission_expected':plan['expected'],
 'scope':'Preparation/CPU-entry rejection/import/constructor/live-wait evidence only. Future counts are planned,not executed. No source or noise draw,checkpoint load,actual matching/frozen/parent/DINO/sampler forward or RAW decode in this preparation. Existing CPU prototype evidence is separate. V175 sources/recipe/owners and machine receipt bytes preserved.'}
public=REPO/'docs/results/v178-CUDA-admission-preparation-v1.json'
with public.open('x') as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
docs=[REPO/p for p in ['README.md','docs/phase-evidence-admission.md','docs/phase-evidence-matching.md',
                      'docs/index.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md']]
links=0
for doc in docs:
 for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',doc.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  assert (doc.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(),(doc,target)
  links+=1
verification={
 'status':'pass-frozen-preparation-live-CPU-wait-sources-protocol-and-document-links',
 'recorded_local':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat(),
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'summary':ref(public),
 'documents':[ref(p) for p in docs],'local_links_checked':links,
 'all_frozen_files_verified':len(plan['frozen_files']),'input_bindings_verified':len(plan['inputs']),
 'watcher_owner':owner,'live_V175_training_owner':train['owner'],'live_V175_completion_watcher_owner':watch175['owner'],
 'new_GPU_calls':0,'new_updates':0,'original_neural_sources_unchanged':96,'sealed_V175_helpers_unchanged':18,
 'scope':'No GPU or scientific worker launched by verification;actual frozen dependency gate probe preserved,not a failed CUDA experiment.'}
with (REPO/'docs/results/v178-CUDA-admission-preparation-verification-v1.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(verification,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('PASS18CPUprotocol-frozen-entry-live-wait7cases32futurecalls0GPU',flush=True)

scope: No GPU or scientific worker launched by verification;actual frozen dependency gate probe preserved,not a failed CUDA experiment.
